question: In which of the following years was India the host of Women's T20 World Cup Cricket?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**2016**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2016 ICC Women’s T20 World Cup** was hosted by **India**, alongside the men’s tournament.
 
• This tournament marked a significant milestone in **women’s cricket**, as it was held simultaneously with the men’s event, garnering more attention and promoting women’s cricket on a global stage.
 
• The final match of the **2016 ICC Women’s T20 World Cup** was held at the **Eden Gardens in Kolkata**, one of the most iconic cricket stadiums in the world.
 
• **West Indies Women** won the tournament by defeating **Australia Women** in the final, claiming their first-ever ICC Women’s T20 title.
 
• This tournament highlighted the growing interest and investment in **women's sports** and the efforts to bring gender parity in cricket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **2012**__

 __
 
• The **2012 ICC Women’s T20 World Cup** was held in **Sri Lanka**.
 
• This was the third edition of the tournament, and **Australia Women** emerged victorious, defeating **England Women** in the final.
 
 
 
• **2014**__
 __
 
• The **2014 ICC Women’s T20 World Cup** was hosted by **Bangladesh**.
 
• Australia Women clinched the title by defeating **England Women** in the final once again, continuing their dominance in women’s cricket.
 
 
 
• **2010**__
 
 
• The **2010 ICC Women’s T20 World Cup** was held in the **West Indies**.
 
• Australia Women won their first T20 title by beating **New Zealand Women** in the final.
